transcript: My sister always chooses her words She pauses quietly first And then she speaks Whenever she speaks I recognize something deeply true in her voice Do not rush Being honest with your own emotions Is the most important thing Her advice is always gentle But it moves my heart When she listens She shows patience When I share an opinion She takes time to consider it Her opinion is always sincere and genuine I hope I will one day have the calm and mature nature she has She encourages me, and she truly does concern herself with my future One evening, she quietly remarked A person can care for others only after they understand themselves Her quiet but steady words stayed with me Affection filled my chest gently

segments.text: My sister always chooses her words
I recognize something deeply true in her voice
Being honest with your own emotions
She takes time to consider it
Her opinion is always sincere and genuine
I hope I will one day have the calm and mature nature she has
She encourages me, and she truly does concern herself with my future
A person can care for others only after they understand themselves
Her quiet but steady words stayed with me
